stories.title: Road Dogg Claims AEW Turned Him Down
stories.tldr: Road Dogg Brian James claimed on social media August 19 that AEW turned him away due to his political beliefs, specifically questioning why he was punished when his father Shad Khan donated to Trump. He also accused wrestling journalist David Bixenspan of screenshotting his conservative social media posts to sabotage his opportunity, though later walked back the specific accusation. James remains unemployed after previous negotiations with TNA stalled.

stories.title: Ricochet Fires Back at Paul Heyman
stories.tldr: AEW star Ricochet fired back at Paul Heyman's August 17 WWE Raw promo in which Heyman justified WWE's business decisions by stating the company answers to shareholders. Ricochet countered that AEW prioritizes fans over shareholders, declaring AEW the "Greatest Wrestling company in the world." The exchange highlighted the philosophical differences between the two promotions regarding their business priorities.

stories.title: Ruby Soho AEW Return Status
stories.tldr: Ruby Soho has been medically cleared for an in-ring return as of June 2024, but her comeback has yet to materialize on AEW television. The former WWE Superstar has been absent since February 2024 due to her pregnancy and birth of her daughter in October 2024, during which time she and her husband Angelo Parker opened a board game cafe. While creative discussions about her return have taken place over recent months, nothing concrete has been decided, and she has not been a regular backstage presence.

stories.title: Kris Statlander on Skye Blue and Wild Match Ideas
stories.tldr: Kris Statlander praised Skye Blue as an underrated talent in AEW's women's division who deserves more recognition despite being with the company since 2021 without winning a title. Statlander also revealed she and Darby Allin are the only AEW wrestlers to pitch getting hit by a car for a match, a concept stemming from her prior stunt double training and gymnastics background.

stories.title: Paul Wight AEW In-Ring Return Interest
stories.tldr: Paul Wight has expressed interest in returning to in-ring competition for AEW, but not for championship pursuits. Instead, the veteran wants to focus on helping younger talent develop through tag team matches and selective appearances, viewing his potential return as an opportunity to mentor the next generation rather than add accolades to his already accomplished career.

stories.title: Britt Baker AEW Return Opponent
stories.tldr: Britt Baker has been absent from AEW television since November 2024, but CEO Tony Khan has expressed interest in her return. The article outlines six potential opponents for Baker's comeback, ranging from former allies like Jamie Hayter to major stars like Thunder Rosa and Toni Storm, with possibilities including a tag team return with Deonna Purrazzo or a high-profile encounter at All In London.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Google Search Interest Analysis
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite's Google search interest is up 20% compared to the previous three months and last year's same period, but the company faces concerning momentum issues heading into All In. Search interest for the London-based PPV is down 70% compared to last year in the United States, suggesting potential weakness in buy-rate projections despite the event being just weeks away.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli Entrance Music Selection
stories.tldr: Claudio Castagnoli of AEW's Death Riders discussed how the process of selecting entrance music has evolved in professional wrestling. Unlike the past when wrestlers were simply assigned their theme songs, modern performers now have significant creative input and collaborate with music producers to craft personalized entrance themes that reflect their character and persona.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Calls Out AEW Tag Titles Understanding
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer engaged in a heated social media debate with former WWE writer Brian "Road Dogg" James over whether the AEW World Tag Team Championships are prestigious enough for Austin and Colten Gunn. Meltzer defended the legitimacy of the titles by citing the accomplished teams who have held them, while James countered by suggesting Meltzer's opinion shouldn't be the only one that matters and ultimately agreed to disagree.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite August 19 2026 Coverage
stories.tldr: Kevin Knight set a pyro trap for Darby Allin, apparently recreating a Jeff Hardy angle from 2009, burning Allin's face and attacking him with a steel chair before he was stretchered out. Konosuke Takeshita made a surprise return and attacked Kyle Fletcher, signaling his intent to reclaim the International Championship at All In, while Kazuchika Okada notably failed to come to Fletcher's aid.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Event Coverage
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega made controversial comments about Will Ospreay's family during their sit-down interview, AEW launched a new "Spill the Tea" digital series hosted by Rachel Bonnetta featuring roster interviews, and a seven-part Will Ospreay docuseries debuted on YouTube documenting his recovery from neck fusion surgery and journey to All In.

stories.title: AEW Collision Women's World Title Match
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale will defend her AEW Women's World Championship against TBS Champion Maya World this Saturday on Collision, just one week before All In in London. The title shot was promised by Nightingale weeks ago if she won the world title, and a potential World victory would dramatically reshape the All In card by making her a double champion heading into her scheduled match with Mercedes Moné.

stories.title: Pat McAfee WWE Return Status
stories.tldr: Pat McAfee has repeatedly and emphatically reiterated that he will never return to WWE television, honoring a promise he made before WrestleMania 42 where he vowed to leave wrestling permanently if Randy Orton lost to Cody Rhodes. Though McAfee admitted he may have been wrong about Rhodes, his increasingly busy schedule at ESPN—which now includes College GameDay, his daily show, and a new Monday Night Countdown role—makes a WWE return unlikely for the foreseeable future.

stories.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 Attendance Figures
stories.tldr: WWE's WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas drew 97,126 attendees according to the Las Vegas Stadium Authority, representing an 18% decline from the previous year's 118,641 attendance at the same venue. The actual attendance figures fell significantly short of WWE's announced 106,071, raising questions about how the company calculates its numbers. WWE President Nick Khan acknowledged that holding WrestleMania in the same city in back-to-back years likely contributed to the drop and suggested the company may avoid repeating this strategy.

stories.title: WWE NXT Updates and Matches
stories.tldr: WWE NXT continues to develop talent and storylines with multiple updates from the August 19 episode and upcoming August 25 show. Ryan Katz, the Director of NXT Creative Operations, served as ring announcer for an Evolve Women's Championship match. NXT General Manager Robert Stone officially announced an eight-man tag team match for next week's show, while Jacy Jayne credited Shawn Michaels for keeping her in NXT long enough to properly develop before her main roster call-up.

stories.title: N3on Penta Fanatics Fest Incident
stories.tldr: N3on continues to maintain he accidentally exposed Penta without his mask during a Fanatics Fest livestream months ago and had no bad intentions. The streamer blames event staff for the incident, stating Penta was told he could remove his mask in a restricted area and N3on was unaware of this. Despite deleting the footage as quickly as possible once he realized what happened, clips had already spread online, and N3on says WWE fans still believe he intentionally exposed the masked luchador's identity.

stories.title: Candice LeRae WWE Push Support
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus has publicly endorsed Candice LeRae for a bigger push in WWE, stating that LeRae "deserves so much more of a spotlight." Stratus made these comments while discussing her brief WWE comeback and reflected on her tag team match with LeRae at Elimination Chamber 2025 in Toronto, praising LeRae's extensive wrestling experience and in-ring abilities.

stories.title: Trish Stratus WWE Return Criteria
stories.tldr: Trish Stratus has outlined specific criteria for any future WWE return, emphasizing that her involvement must serve a greater purpose beyond personal gain. She prioritizes helping younger talent develop, creating meaningful storylines, and long-term planning over simply appearing on television. Her recent work with Zoey Stark and Tiffany Stratton demonstrate her philosophy of strategic storytelling and mentorship.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown and RAW Viewership
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown viewership declined week-over-week on August 14, 2024, drawing 1.247 million viewers on USA Network, down from 1.470 million the previous week. The show's 18-49 demographic rating also dropped to 0.30 from 0.35. CM Punk's verbal confrontation with Kevin Owens generated the most YouTube engagement among SmackDown segments.

stories.title: Triple H WWE Management and Hiring Decisions
stories.tldr: Jim Johnston, the legendary WWE composer behind iconic theme songs, revealed that Triple H does not view him favorably and perceives him as "Vince's guy," making his return to WWE highly unlikely. The report also covers updates on Ruby Soho's AEW status, potential involvement of Sting's son with the company, and speculation about Brock Lesnar's wrestling future.

stories.title: WWE Stars Being Repackaged
stories.tldr: WWE has several underutilized stars who could benefit from character repackaging and fresh creative direction. The article examines five wrestlers including Josh Briggs, Kiana James, American Made, Jordynne Grace, and Ilja Dragunov who have struggled to connect with audiences in their current presentations and could see career improvements through reinvention, similar to recent success stories like Grayson Waller.

stories.title: WWE Tag Team Division and Lucha Brothers
stories.tldr: WWE's tag team division is struggling on Raw and SmackDown in 2026, prompting reports of new roster pairings being created. The long-awaited reunion of Penta and Rey Fenix, the former AEW World Tag Team Champions who were kept separate since their 2025 debuts, could be the spark needed to revitalize the division. Recent tournament storylines hint at a potential match between the brothers, which could set up their tag team reunion and establish them as top contenders.

stories.title: Nia Jax WWE Ring Work Commentary
stories.tldr: Nia Jax has stopped defending herself against longstanding criticism about being dangerous in the ring, instead embracing the label during a recent radio appearance. She stated matter-of-factly that wrestlers are supposed to be dangerous and made clear that anyone who gets in her way will face consequences. The conversation touched on her 2018 incident with Becky Lynch and even resulted in her delivering a chop to a radio host.

stories.title: Blake Monroe and Rhea Ripley Storyline
stories.tldr: WWE's Blake Monroe has called out Rhea Ripley, claiming the Australian star is avoiding her and joking that Ripley suffered a knee injury out of fear following Monroe's main roster debut. Ripley is expected to be sidelined for the rest of 2026 after tearing her meniscus, while Monroe looks to climb the SmackDown ranks to earn a title shot.

stories.title: Randy Orton WWE Faction and Feud
stories.tldr: Randy Orton is back on WWE television and pursuing both a feud with Cody Rhodes and the Undisputed WWE Championship held by CM Punk. To achieve his goals, Orton may assemble a new faction, with potential recruits ranging from established NXT talent like Myles Borne and Je'Von Evans to main roster performers like Ricky Saints. The strategy mirrors Orton's successful 2009 Legacy group, which featured other second-generation wrestlers.

stories.title: The Miz on WWE Grade Criticism
stories.tldr: The Miz has criticized Bleacher Report's WWE coverage, claiming the outlet grades wrestling shows as if the reviewer is an uninformed fan rather than understanding WWE's actual creative intentions. While praising Bleacher Report's sports coverage as top-tier, Miz argued the wrestling grades lack realism and perspective. He clarified he welcomes constructive criticism but dismisses baseless negativity, which he says has actually motivated him throughout his 20-year career.

stories.title: Nattie and Total Divas Return
stories.tldr: Nattie has revealed that she, the Bella Twins, and WWE President Nick Khan are actively working to bring back the reality TV show Total Divas. The former cast members believe the show inspired current WWE wrestlers to join the promotion, and they remain committed to reviving the series for the modern women's roster.

stories.title: Matt Cardona WWE Radio Announcement Omission
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona was noticeably upset when WWE Radio announced its programming lineup without mentioning his name, despite his weekly "Broski Breakdown" segment continuing on NotSam Wrestling Live every Tuesday. While Cardona joked about thinking he'd been fired, he admitted the omission actually bothered him during an appearance on Busted Open Radio.

stories.title: Indie Wrestler Rejects WWE Office Job
stories.tldr: Leo Sparrow, an independent wrestler from Long Island, turned down a full-time corporate position with WWE's community relations department during the COVID-19 pandemic to pursue his wrestling dream. Instead, he chose to train at Create A Pro Wrestling Academy and has since appeared on both WWE RAW and AEW Rampage in the same week, facing notable competitors like MJF along the way.

stories.title: MVP and John Laurinaitis WWE Incident
stories.tldr: MVP revealed on his podcast that he nearly fought with John Laurinaitis at a WWE hotel bar after the executive suggested he should have hired a private jet to make a missed show. The conversation escalated when Laurinaitis claimed he looked out for MVP, leading to a heated exchange where both men challenged each other to fight until Kevin Dunn intervened and mediated an apology, though Laurinaitis refused to shake hands afterward.

stories.title: Kevin Owens WWE Title Match Against CM Punk
stories.tldr: Owens has revealed he completed his four-week medical clearance in just nine days by doing all recovery tasks back-to-back, and explained his mindset has fundamentally shifted since his injury—he now views every match as a gift and no longer feels the pressure to constantly achieve more, just to enjoy whatever time he has left in the ring.

stories.title: Chelsea Green WWE Injury Update
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona revealed he's actually glad Chelsea Green got injured because her emotional promo on SmackDown made her a "made woman" in WWE. AJ Styles confirmed Green is doing well at the Performance Center and expects her to wear a protective mask, while comparing her resilience to Becky Lynch's career-defining moment.

stories.title: Paul Heyman WWE Commentary and Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: During an appearance on The Undertaker's podcast, Paul Heyman confirmed that Brock Lesnar's retirement following his SummerSlam loss to Oba Femi is genuine this time, noting Lesnar had made this decision well in advance rather than emotionally. Heyman also reflected on Lesnar ending The Undertaker's WrestleMania streak as the defining moment of its generation, comparing it to Hogan-Andre and the Austin-Tyson era.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar WWE Retirement
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff has weighed in on whether Brock Lesnar might compete for Real American Freestyle after his WWE retirement, saying it's unlikely but not impossible given Lesnar's deep roots in amateur wrestling. Bischoff cited Lesnar's preference for farm life, his desire to support his daughter's Olympic shot put goals, and his discomfort with public appearances as major obstacles to an RAF appearance.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans WWE Injury and Return
stories.tldr: Je'Von Evans has revealed new details about the head collision that stopped his January RAW match, explaining that he told the referee he was "seeing stars" but tried to downplay the injury. WWE medical made the call to halt the match despite Evans' initial resistance, a decision he now acknowledges was the right call. He returned to action just two weeks later at the Royal Rumble.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Title Shot Controversy
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu's guarantee of an NXT Championship match in his WWE debut has sparked immediate backlash from fans who view it as nepotism, particularly given that Fatu had just promised he wasn't a "nepo baby." The timing of the announcement—just minutes after he pledged to let his talent speak for itself—has intensified accusations that WWE is handing opportunities to Anoa'i family members regardless of experience.

stories.title: Jim Johnston WWE Music Return Possibility
stories.tldr: Jim Johnston doubled down on his belief that a WWE return is essentially impossible, citing his perception as a "Vince McMahon guy" that has created distance with Triple H. He expressed willingness to work in wrestling music again but emphasized he would need to be asked. Johnston also questioned why WWE would bring him back when they have current composers handling their themes.

stories.title: Lainey Reid on Chelsea Green and Fatal Influence
stories.tldr: Lainey Reid doubled down on her dismissive attitude toward Chelsea Green's injury, claiming Fatal Influence actually helped elevate Green's career and expressing regret only that they didn't cause more damage. Reid credited herself and Fallon Henley for Green's successful championship segment, while noting the strong style wrestling that injured Green is a signature of Fatal Influence that opponents aren't prepared for.

stories.title: Wrestling Commentary and Analysis
stories.tldr: Wrestling remains a powerful cultural phenomenon that connects fans across demographics through affordable, non-judgmental storytelling that reflects personal struggles and emotions. From nostalgic title change histories to contemporary matches earning critical acclaim, the sport continues to deliver meaningful narratives, though industry veterans like Kevin Nash struggle with revisiting painful stories of lost colleagues featured in documentaries.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling REVOLT Partnership
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has announced a major content partnership with REVOLT, the cultural authority platform, to bring exclusive TNA Xplosion matches and 24 years of premium content to REVOLT and REVOLT Sports beginning this fall. The partnership leverages the historical connection between hip-hop and professional wrestling, with both industries sharing storytelling, larger-than-life characters, and passionate fan communities. The agreement aims to expand TNA's global reach while introducing the next generation of fans to wrestling content.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Symphony Battle of Five Points
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling Symphony will host Battle of Five Points on September 12 at Bongo Java East + Game Point's in East Nashville, featuring a PWS Championship triple threat match headlined by champion Colby Carter defending against Jake Painter and Kody Lane. The card includes title matches for the tag team and women's championships, along with several other featured bouts from local talent. Tickets start at $20 with all ages welcome, and food trucks and beer vendors will be available.

stories.title: N3on Penta Mask Exposure Incident
stories.tldr: N3on has clarified that Fanatics Fest staff were responsible for the incident where Penta's unmasked face was accidentally shown on his livestream in July. N3on claims he had no bad intentions, immediately deleted the footage once he discovered it, but the clips had already circulated on social media before he could act. Despite his apology to Penta at the time, N3on says fans still blame him for intentionally exposing the masked wrestler.

stories.title: NWA Billy Corgan on Wrestling Growth
stories.tldr: NWA owner Billy Corgan believes professional wrestling is on the verge of entering a major mainstream growth period, but the industry must stop treating itself as a niche product to achieve this goal. He credits WWE's merger with TKO Group Holdings and the reach of streaming platforms as catalysts for mainstream acceptance. Corgan argues wrestling should appeal to broad audiences like blockbuster movies do, rather than catering only to dedicated niche fans.

stories.title: Lucha Underground YouTube Schedule
stories.tldr: Lucha Underground has launched an official YouTube channel featuring archived episodes from its entire run, with new episodes uploading three times per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. The channel is currently up to season one, episode 19 and will continue archiving the promotion's complete catalog. The legendary wrestling promotion, which ran from 2014 to 2018, was developed by Mark Burnett and Robert Rodriguez.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax Final Josh Barnett
stories.tldr: Josh Barnett defended the legitimacy of headlock submissions as finishing moves following Ryohei Oiwa's G1 Climax victory using the Big Lock. Barnett cited historical precedent from UWF veteran Masahiro Kakihara and catch wrestling principles, challenging Dave Meltzer's criticism that the move isn't realistic in actual combat. Oiwa will challenge IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji at King of Pro-Wrestling in October.

stories.title: Rocky Romero on AEW Star Comparison
stories.tldr: Rocky Romero recently praised Ring of Honor World Champion Bandido during an appearance on the What Happened When podcast with Tony Schiavone, comparing him favorably to Rey Mysterio and suggesting he has the potential to become AEW World Champion. Romero made these comments while discussing a 20-minute match he had with Bandido at ROH Road to G1 Supercard: San Antonio in 2019. Bandido will defend his ROH title against Nick Wayne at the upcoming Death Before Dishonor PPV this Friday, following back-to-back title defenses earlier in the week.

stories.title: Val Venis on Dustin Rhodes Anti-Islam Controversy
stories.tldr: Val Venis has defended Dustin Rhodes over backlash regarding Rhodes' response to an anti-Islam Twitter post, arguing that Rhodes unknowingly reacted to a political post without understanding its context. Venis blamed cancel culture and criticized Mustafa Ali's involvement, characterizing Rhodes as an entertainer who lacks expertise in politics and simply made an innocent mistake.

stories.title: Current WWE Stars Leaving for AEW
stories.tldr: An article examines five current WWE wrestlers who could potentially leave for AEW in the coming years, including Bayley, who has achieved everything in WWE and could benefit from a fresh start like Mercedes Moné did. The list also features underutilized talent like Giulia and Ricky Saints, who have struggled to gain momentum on the main roster despite initial expectations of major success.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Says NXT Women Are Outperforming the Men
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens recently stated that NXT's women wrestlers are significantly outperforming their male counterparts in terms of in-ring work and overall performance. Echoing comments made by Grayson Waller weeks earlier, Owens believes the women's division is so strong that fans attending NXT's Canadian tour will primarily remember the women's matches. He expressed optimism about the future of WWE's women's division based on the current talent developing in NXT.

stories.title: Daily Update: Paul Heyman, AEW Spill The Tea, TNA
stories.tldr: Paul Heyman reflected on Brock Lesnar's historic victory over The Undertaker at WrestleMania 30, emphasizing how the finish and crowd reaction overshadowed the match itself, which was physically compromised by Undertaker's concussion. Heyman highlighted the importance of storytelling and crowd psychology in professional wrestling, noting that audiences remember pivotal moments and finishes rather than technical execution. The update also covers various wrestling news including Kevin Owens' WWE return mindset, AEW's growth metrics, TNA payment disputes, and coverage of international wrestling promotions.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling Star Claims It Took Six Months For Him To Get Paid During Dixie Carter Era
stories.tldr: Former TNA wrestler Grado revealed on Jeff Jarrett's podcast that he experienced severe payment delays during the Dixie Carter era, going nearly six months without a paycheck at one point. Despite the financial hardship, Grado was initially unbothered because he was still employed as a firefighter and thrilled to have his travel expenses covered to wrestle in the United States. The payment issues persisted across multiple stretches, eventually forcing him to speak up about the situation.

stories.title: Former TNA performer claims he went nearly six months without being paid during Dixie Carter era
stories.tldr: Former TNA wrestler Grado revealed on Jeff Jarrett's podcast that he went nearly six months without receiving payment during his time with the company under Dixie Carter's ownership. Though he eventually received back pay, Grado explained he was initially unbothered by the lack of payment since he was working as a firefighter and simply enjoyed wrestling in the United States with his flights covered. The situation only became an issue after multiple payment delays occurred during his tenure.

stories.title: The Sandman Believes Batista Was Better Suited To Hardcore Wrestling
stories.tldr: During episode 135 of The Sandman Podcast, the ECW legend argued that Batista's wrestling abilities were overrated and that he would have been better suited to hardcore matches rather than conventional wrestling. While acknowledging Batista's undeniable charisma and star power that made him a major WWE name, Sandman maintained that the former World Heavyweight Champion was a "mid-level worker" whose physical presence would have translated better to ECW's brawling and weapons-based style. The discussion was part of a broader examination of WWE's failed 2006 ECW revival, which the panel criticized for pushing established main roster stars over ECW originals and emerging talent.

stories.title: Je’Von Evans Reveals Ring Name He Wanted To Use In WWE
stories.tldr: Je'Von Evans revealed that WWE asked him to submit 10 potential ring names just days before his Level Up debut, and he wanted to be called Je'Von Porter to be the first Porter in WWE history. However, WWE pointed out that MVP's full name is Montel Vontavious Porter, so the company settled on Je'Von Evans instead, which has remained his name since his 2023 debut.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor Card
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander is not under contract with ROH despite multiple recent appearances, though those within AEW have been impressed with her work. Nigel McGuinness confirmed he will compete for the ROH Pure Championship on Friday despite an ankle injury suffered at the Continental Challenge Cup, putting his entire ROH career on the line if he loses.

stories.title: Blue Meanie Injury and Family Loss Support
stories.tldr: Blue Meanie has launched a GoFundMe campaign to help his family cover funeral expenses for his brother-in-law Bill, who passed away from Parkinson's disease on August 16. The wrestler expressed gratitude for fan support during this difficult period, noting that the kindness has helped him emotionally while he recovers from broken ribs and grieves his loss.

stories.title: Paul Wight on Paying Dues Concept
stories.tldr: Paul Wight expanded on his criticism of the "paying dues" concept in a new podcast appearance, characterizing it as a tactic veterans use to intimidate and bully younger talent. He challenged the logic of punishing wrestlers for having early success or better opportunities, arguing the industry should focus on mentoring rather than hazing younger performers.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Says AEW Grand Slam Mexico Reaction Matched 2020 Royal Rumble
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland compared the reaction he received at AEW Grand Slam Mexico to his surprise 2020 Royal Rumble return, saying it was so overwhelming he temporarily left his body. Tony Schiavone texted him afterward saying he'd never heard anything like it in his long career. Copeland credited fans understanding his time at legendary venues may be limited, making the moment special for everyone involved.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Agrees That Women Are Out-Doing Men In WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens elaborated on his comments about NXT's women outperforming the men, predicting that fans attending the upcoming Canadian tour will leave talking primarily about the women's performances. Owens emphasized the exceptional talent and bright future of WWE's women's division based on what he's witnessing in NXT.

stories.title: Mark Sterling takes a NASTY bump, proceeds to milk it for all its worth
stories.tldr: After receiving a clean bill of health, Mark Sterling capitalized on his viral bump by leaning into the injury angle on social media, demanding the footage be kept in the broadcast, deflecting production criticism, and using the moment to promote his action figures with characteristic humor and salesmanship.

stories.title: Backstage News On How WWE Views Roman Reigns Internally, Update On Plans For Title Defense
stories.tldr: WWE's tournament for Roman Reigns' next challenger is down to its final four, with semifinal matches set for August 24 Raw in Ottawa. The tournament final will air on Raw rather than at AAA TripleMania 34. Internally, WWE has Reigns categorized as a heel following Monday's segment where Solo Sikoa attacked him and LA Knight sided against him.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes Social Media Controversy
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Dustin Rhodes faced significant backlash on X after reacting with emojis to a post containing Islamophobic and transphobic messaging. Rhodes claimed he only liked the firearm in the photo and hadn't read the caption, prompting an apology to TNA's Mustafa Ali, who accepted it while urging caution. Rhodes subsequently made his X account private and suggested he may leave the platform entirely.

stories.title: Paul Wight Commentary on Wrestling Industry
stories.tldr: Paul Wight has strongly criticized the wrestling industry's "paying your dues" mentality, calling it an excuse for veterans to bully younger talent. The former Big Show defended Avery Styles in the recent controversy and argued that the concept is outdated, though his comments have drawn criticism from former NXT UK wrestler Sam Gradwell, who accused Wight of being harsh to tryout talent during a WWE stint.

stories.title: Steph De Lander AEW/ROH Opportunity
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander and her husband Mance Warner have been pulled from an independent wrestling show in Alabama to appear at AEW Collision and ROH tapings in Reading, Pennsylvania on Saturday. De Lander is set to challenge Deonna Purrazzo for the ROH Women's Pure Championship, stemming from an injury that occurred during a title defense in June. The indie promotion released both wrestlers without issue and confirmed they will return when schedules permit.

stories.title: Steve Borden (Sting's Son) AEW Contract Status
stories.tldr: Steven Borden, son of legendary wrestler Sting, is believed to be officially signed with AEW following his retirement from in-ring competition at Revolution 2024. He has been consistently working dark matches for the company since December and has competed in more than two dozen matches while developing as a professional wrestler. His brother Garrett is also training to become a wrestler and is on AEW's radar, though his contract status remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite and Continental Challenge Cup Updates
stories.tldr: Renee Paquette will pull double duty on Wednesday's Dynamite, conducting separate interviews with Kenny Omega/Will Ospreay and Willow Nightingale/Mercedes Mone ahead of All In. The Continental Cup quarterfinals are set to begin with Moxley facing Jay White and Nigel McGuinness taking on Hechicero on the show. Mistico has expressed his ambitions to capture AEW's World Championship and main event at the company's biggest shows.

stories.title: Jim Ross Brain Surgery Recovery and AEW All In 2026
stories.tldr: Jim Ross has extended his hospital stay longer than initially expected following his August 12 brain shunt surgery, but remains optimistic about his recovery. He's actively undergoing rehab and physical therapy with a firm goal of being cleared to call matches at AEW All In on August 30 at Wembley Stadium, less than two weeks away. His contract with AEW expires sometime this month, and his ability to work the London event remains unconfirmed pending continued medical clearance.

stories.title: MJF and NJPW G1 Climax Challenge
stories.tldr: MJF escalated his war of words with Ryohei Oiwa by calling him a "f*cking dork" and lumping him in with other wrestlers he dismisses as "fake tough guys," including Will Ospreay, Kenny Omega, and Andrade El Idolo. MJF also claimed he has nothing left to prove in the G1 Climax, already considering himself the best in the world. The exchange remains unclear as to whether it's serious or part of MJF's social media gimmick.

stories.title: WWE NXT Heatwave 2026 Event Coverage
stories.tldr: WWE NXT Heatwave on August 30 will feature five confirmed title matches, headlined by a Fatal Four-Way for the NXT Championship between Tony D'Angelo, Grayson Waller, Cruz Montana, and debuting Zilla Fatu. The card was shaped by Naraku's shocking return on August 18, which cost Shiloh Hill a North American Championship opportunity and triggered a stipulation sending Jackson Drake and Vanity Project into title matches.

stories.title: WWE NXT Championship and Title Matches
stories.tldr: WWE NXT is experiencing significant changes with veteran performers like Cruz Montana arriving to restore the brand's prestige, while younger talents like Je'Von Evans set ambitious records-setting goals. The NXT Championship picture remains active with Tony D'Angelo as champion, facing various contenders including potential involvement from debuting Zilla Fatu. Recent programming has featured competitive matches and interference angles that continue to shape the championship storyline.

stories.title: Jim Johnston WWE Music Composer Future
stories.tldr: Jim Johnston, the legendary WWE music composer responsible for iconic themes for The Rock, Steve Austin, and The Undertaker, says he would be willing to create entrance music again but believes Triple H has virtually no chance of asking him back. Johnston believes Triple H perceives him as Vince McMahon's guy and has wanted his own people since transitioning to a behind-the-scenes role, making a reunion highly unlikely.

stories.title: WWE Peacock Subscription Price Increases
stories.tldr: Peacock has announced its fourth price increase in four years, with the ad-supported Premium tier rising from $10.99 to $12.99 per month and Premium Plus jumping from $16.99 to $19.99 per month. The changes take effect immediately for new subscribers on August 18 and for existing customers on or after September 17. WWE fans will be affected as they rely on Peacock to watch Saturday Night's Main Event and the upcoming Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6, though the service cited the need to "remain competitive in the marketplace" and continue investing in programming.

stories.title: IShowSpeed WWE Debut and Return Plans
stories.tldr: IShowSpeed has announced he will return to WWE "very soon" following his well-received appearance at WrestleMania 42, where he competed in an undercard match and turned on Logan Paul. The popular streamer confirmed his imminent return during a Twitch stream on August 18, 2026, marking a stronger commitment than his previous non-committal statements about potentially taking WWE more seriously. While no specific date or event has been confirmed, Speed's positive reception from both fans and WWE backstage suggests the company views him as a successful celebrity addition to their programming.

stories.title: The Rock and Cody Rhodes WWE Story
stories.tldr: While The Rock's Hollywood career appears uncertain following Moana's box office disappointment, WWE Hall of Famer Diamond Dallas Page believes a long-awaited singles match between The Rock and Cody Rhodes is inevitable. The two stars have crossed paths multiple times since 2024, including a WrestleMania tag team encounter, but have never faced one-on-one despite fan anticipation and their well-documented history.

stories.title: EK Prosper AAA Cruiserweight Title Shot
stories.tldr: EK Prosper won a Fatal Four-Way #1 Contender's Match on the August 18 episode of WWE NXT, defeating La Parka, Romeo Moreno, and Tristan Angels to earn a shot at Rey Fenix's AAA World Cruiserweight Championship. Prosper will challenge Fenix for the title on the August 25 episode of NXT, marking his first opportunity to win AAA gold since joining WWE and Fenix's eighth title defense.

stories.title: Asuka WWE Status Update
stories.tldr: Asuka has been absent from WWE programming since May, but a new backstage report indicates WWE is eager to bring her back whenever she feels ready. The Empress of Tomorrow is now operating under a part-time schedule and can return on short notice without advance announcement. Her comeback could happen unexpectedly at any time, as she teased in a previous video message to fans.

stories.title: WWE Raw on Netflix Viewership
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer has released his weekly analysis of WWE Raw's viewership numbers on Netflix, including comparative data on how the show performs against AEW Dynamite. The report examines audience metrics and trends for both promotions as they compete for viewership. The full details are available to paying subscribers of his newsletter.

stories.title: WWE RAW and SmackDown General Updates
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez has published his detailed report covering Monday's WWE Raw episode from August 17, 2026, now available to subscribers. The report provides comprehensive analysis and coverage of the show's matches, segments, and storyline developments. While specific match details and results are not included in this excerpt, Alvarez's coverage offers subscriber-exclusive insights into the episode's key happenings.

stories.title: WWE NXT Start Time and Show Info
stories.tldr: WWE NXT airs tonight on the CW at 8pm ET with a stacked card featuring multiple title matches and compelling storylines. The show will be broadcast from the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, with global start times provided for international viewers across all time zones.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Praises Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy recently praised Brock Lesnar as the most intimidating legitimate athlete he's ever worked with, reflecting on their early interactions during Lesnar's initial WWE run. In the same interview, Hardy named his favorite championship victory as winning the WWE World Tag Team Championship with Jeff Hardy in 1999, explaining that the titles held legendary significance to him as a childhood dream.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez Survivor Series 2026
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez is excited about WWE Survivor Series 2026 taking place in her home state of Texas, particularly in Houston. She expressed her love for the WarGames cage match structure and teased the possibility of hitting another Tejana Bomb on John Cena, referencing last year's encounter. Rodriguez also discussed her background in basketball and her former aspirations to play in the WNBA before committing to professional wrestling.

stories.title: Bully Ray WWE Commentary
stories.tldr: Bully Ray criticized a WWE Raw segment where Jacob Fatu stood passively in the corner while Solo Sikoa attacked Roman Reigns and the rest of the Bloodline. Ray questioned whether Fatu was too obedient to Reigns' earlier directive to stay back, or if WWE should have clarified the storyline logic. Ray also noted that Reigns' decision to acknowledge the Usos as "captains" without doing the same for Fatu could plant seeds for Fatu to eventually join Solo's faction.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans WWE Career and Matches
stories.tldr: Evans has reflected on multiple recent incidents in his WWE career, including a botched RKO spot with Randy Orton that he avoided rewatching for months, a scary head collision during a Raw match that forced medical stoppage, and a first IC Championship challenge against Penta where he suffered a tailbone injury on the announce table. He's now "locked in and focused" on becoming the youngest IC Champion within the next year while navigating competition from established stars.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: AJ Styles revealed he was the producer for the match where Zilla Fatu made his debut and praised the young star's intimidating presence and athleticism. Booker T, who trained Fatu at Reality of Wrestling, expressed pride in his former student and noted parallels in their backgrounds, including losing their fathers early in life. Fatu has officially signed his NXT contract following the debut.

stories.title: WWE RAW Roman Reigns and Solo Sikoa Story
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa has escalated his message to Roman Reigns via social media, warning that "The Bloodline will fall sooner than later." Jacob Fatu mysteriously walked away from the group after the RAW segment, fueling speculation he may also turn on Reigns. WWE has officially listed Reigns as a heel on its internal roster, signaling a complete character shift for the Champion.

stories.title: WWE NXT Roster and Talent Updates
stories.tldr: Jacy Jayne opened up about nearly missing her main roster opportunity, crediting her extended NXT tenure with preparing her for success. Meanwhile, Zilla Fatu officially signed with WWE and was added to a four-way NXT Championship match at Heatwave, while Aalyah Mysterio has quietly signed a full-time NXT deal. NXT will also tour Canada for the first time in seven years this October.

stories.title: Chad Gable vs Rey Mysterio WWE RAW Match
stories.tldr: Gable retained his Intercontinental Championship against Mysterio on Raw, defeating him with a counter pin after Mysterio reversed an ankle lock attempt. In a post-match Instagram statement, Gable praised Mysterio's humility and longevity, calling their encounter "everything I love about Pro Wrestling" and saying it made him "feel alive."

stories.title: WWE Raw and SmackDown Taping Schedule
stories.tldr: WWE is taping four episodes across two nights in late August to prep for a hectic September schedule that includes live events in Mexico, TripleMania, and UFC programming. The company will return to its regular live schedule on September 7. Stephanie Vaquer is returning to in-ring competition at the Ottawa Raw against Roxanne Perez, and Roman Reigns will defend his World Heavyweight Championship in Mexico City on September 14.

stories.title: AJ Styles WWE Commentary and Involvement
stories.tldr: Styles has expanded his media presence beyond advocating for LA Knight, now commenting on other wrestlers' current situations. He recently spoke with injured WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green at the Performance Center and praised her resilience, while also offering high praise for Rey Mysterio's continued excellence at age 51 following a strong Intercontinental Championship defense.

stories.title: Rey Mysterio and El Fiscal WWE Involvement
stories.tldr: Rey Mysterio personally advocated for El Fiscal's inclusion in the WWE World Heavyweight Championship tournament, though Fiscal fell short in his debut match. Meanwhile, Rey Fenix's next defense of his AAA Cruiserweight title is set for NXT against EK Prosper on August 25, while Fenix continues his pursuit of a Roman Reigns title shot in Mexico City on September 14.

stories.title: Grayson Waller CM Punk Confrontation
stories.tldr: Following his backstage confrontation with CM Punk at an NXT live event, Grayson Waller took to social media to mock the rest of the NXT locker room for embracing the WWE Champion. Waller posted photos comparing his defiant stance against Punk to other wrestlers posing happily with the champion, emphasizing that he operates differently from his peers.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer WWE Return
stories.tldr: Vaquer's return match against Roxanne Perez is now officially scheduled for RAW on Aug. 24 in Ontario, Canada. The show will air two hours earlier than usual due to a double television taping. RAW will also feature World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contendership Tournament semifinals and a contract signing between Bron Breakker and Oba Femi ahead of their Main Event clash.

stories.title: Zelina Vega WWE Release
stories.tldr: Xelina Vega has opened up about her WWE release, explaining that she took it in stride by focusing on the positive aspects of her nearly 10-year career with the company. She also detailed her reasoning behind her name change, saying it allows her to present her authentic self without corporate constraints. Both she and Aleister Black are now free agents pursuing independent opportunities.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor 2026
stories.tldr: ROH Death Before Dishonor 2026 takes place Friday, August 21 from Philadelphia's 2300 Arena and will not air on traditional television. The event is available via streaming through HonorClub in North America and India, or MyAEW in the UK, Australia and Europe, with the show starting at 7pm ET and early morning times for international viewers.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Stardom Wrestling Experience
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe credits her time wrestling in Stardom, where she couldn't speak Japanese, with helping her develop "The Glamour" character by forcing her to rely on body language, clothing, and mannerisms instead of promos. Her inability to cut promos in Japan forced her to amplify her character work to 100%, a level she maintained when transitioning to American wrestling, where she also benefited from working with charismatic performers.

stories.title: Brock Rechsteiner Cowboys-Saints Practice
stories.tldr: Brock Rechsteiner, son of WWE Hall of Famer Scott Steiner, executed a suplex-style takedown during an altercation at a joint Cowboys-Saints practice on Tuesday. The incident began when Rechsteiner was involved in a shoving match with Cowboys cornerback Caelen Carson before being pulled into a confrontation with safety Jalen Thompson. Rechsteiner is currently serving a six-game NFL suspension for a performance-enhancing substances violation and has been rumored as a potential future WWE signing.

stories.title: Mark Sterling ROH Injury
stories.tldr: Mark Sterling took a dangerous bump on ROH TV when Komander kicked him off the apron, causing him to land directly on his head and neck in a scorpion pose position. Sterling subsequently gave a cryptic update on social media simply stating "No" when asked if he was okay, leaving fans concerned about his condition following the incident.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer and General Wrestling News
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Radio covered a packed episode including RAW recaps, the Continental Challenge Cup tournament, NJPW and Stardom lineups, CMLL and ROH news, G1 Climax 36 finals analysis, and notable stories like Hiroyoshi Tenzan's retirement and an AI recreation of Antonio Inoki.

stories.title: Ric Flair Personal Life
stories.tldr: At 77 years old, Ric Flair dismissed rumors that he plans to marry for a sixth time and start a new family, humorously responding on Twitter that he hasn't even met his supposed next wife. The wrestling legend joked that someone needs to introduce him to the woman he's allegedly planning to marry, while clarifying that starting a new family is not part of his plans.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Assumes WWE Wouldn’t Let Him Be Part Of John Cena Retirement Tour
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland discussed why he didn't appear during John Cena's WWE retirement tour, revealing he assumed WWE wouldn't permit an AEW talent to participate despite believing both Tony Khan and Cena himself would have been open to it. Copeland acknowledged the historic significance of his rivalry with Cena and noted that while the two competitors made their careers partly on each other, he realized WWE's mindset wouldn't allow the appearance to happen.

stories.title: Lexis King Retains WWE Men's Speed Title Thanks To Numbers Advantage
stories.tldr: Lexis King successfully defended his WWE Men's Speed Championship against Lucien Price of OTM during NXT, with crucial interference from his Birthright stablemates Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey in the closing seconds. King's strategy of running down the clock and using the numbers advantage proved effective, as his allies tripped up Price just as he was setting up a finishing move, allowing King to hit the Coronation for the pin.

stories.title: Paul Wight Knew His WWE Run Was Over After One Vince McMahon Moment
stories.tldr: Paul Wight realized his WWE in-ring career was finished when Vince McMahon started calling him "Paul" instead of "Show" or "Big Show" during the COVID era, signaling a shift toward non-performing ambassador duties. Though there was nothing malicious about it, Wight wasn't ready to retire and instead signed with AEW in February 2021 after his final WWE appearance in January 2021.

stories.title: Dawn Marie Reveals Why She’s Joining OnlyFans After Nearly 10 Years As A Nurse
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Dawn Marie, 55, has launched an OnlyFans account after nearly a decade working as a nurse, citing the physical toll of nursing on her body due to previous neck surgery rather than financial hardship. She clarified that the page will feature fun, flirtatious content without nudity, and emphasized she is embracing her current age and life stage rather than attempting to recreate her wrestling-era image. The venture is intended as a financial safeguard for her future as a single mother with children in college.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Says WHC No. 1 Contender's Tournament Finals Will Take Place On WWE Raw
stories.tldr: WWE's World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 contender tournament finals will take place on WWE Raw in Mexico City on September 14, rather than at AAA's Triplemania 34 the weekend before. The semi-finals will feature Rey Fenix vs. Dragon Lee and Penta vs. La Parka, with reports suggesting the finals will be a matchup between brothers Penta and Rey Fenix, with the winner facing Roman Reigns for the title.

stories.title: Former WWE Diva Dawn Marie addresses her decision to start an OnlyFans account
stories.tldr: Former WWE Diva Dawn Marie has launched an OnlyFans account, which she clarified will not include nude content. The 55-year-old explained that after nearly a decade working as a nurse with significant physical limitations from past neck surgery, she is preparing financially for her future while being a single mother supporting her children's college education.

stories.title: WWE NXT Google Search interest and analysis (last 90 days comparative)
stories.tldr: WWE NXT search interest has declined 20% compared to the previous three months and 7% year-over-year, though the August 12 episode featuring Zilla Fatu's debut peaked at maximum search interest in months. The upcoming NXT Heatwave event shows strong momentum with 50% more search interest than last year, and upcoming competition from AEW's All In event could further boost visibility.

stories.title: Dax Harwood FTR Independent Wrestling and Career Milestones
stories.tldr: Dax Harwood challenged the Road Warriors' claim as the greatest tag team of all time, arguing that FTR's body of work should rank above them and praising the Young Bucks as potentially the greatest ever. He also emphasized that wrestling at prestigious venues like MSG or the Tokyo Dome holds no special significance to him compared to smaller venues.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax 2026 Coverage
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer praised NJPW's G1 Climax booking for finally pushing new talent like Oiwa and Uemura into the spotlight rather than relying on established stars. Bryan Alvarez hailed the finals match as one of his favorites of the year, particularly praising how the performers built drama around submission holds. However, one critic warns that strong booking means nothing if NJPW fails to maintain momentum, noting the promotion squandered similar goodwill earlier in 2026.

stories.title: GCW Drake Wuertz Controversy
stories.tldr: Brett Lauderdale acknowledged that Wuertz previously expressed "extreme views" that were "offensive" and "dangerous," but defended giving him a second chance based on Wuertz's personal help during Lauderdale's 2012 battle with opioid addiction. Lauderdale stated he has been waiting years to repay Wuertz for taking him to his first Narcotics Anonymous meeting on March 29, 2012, which set him on the path to recovery.

stories.title: Adam Copeland Believed WWE Would Block Him From John Cena’s Farewell Run
stories.tldr: Copeland revealed he never seriously pursued a match with Cena during his farewell tour because he assumed WWE would reject it based on past experience with the company's policies toward outside talent. He believes Khan would have approved, and while tribute spots were exchanged between them on both promotions' programming, an actual match never materialized due to Copeland's assumption rather than active negotiation.

stories.title: Naraku Comes To Aid Of Vanity Project On WWE NXT, With Heatwave Implications
stories.tldr: Naraku's surprise interference helped Jackson Drake defeat Shiloh Hill in a high-stakes contender match on NXT, securing Drake an NXT North American Championship match against Myles Borne at Heatwave. The Vanity Project will also compete for the NXT Tag Team Championships at the August 30 event after Drake's victory fulfilled the match stipulations.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone WWE Negotiations During AEW All In 2023
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone revealed that she was still negotiating with WWE when she attended AEW All In 2023 at Wembley Stadium as a fan. During the event, Tony Khan expressed excitement about having her there and wanted her to do a backstage segment with Willow Nightingale, despite Mone not being signed. The experience of watching the historic event and the energy she felt ultimately convinced her that AEW was the right place for her career.

stories.title: Chris Jericho AEW Creative Process
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho has returned to AEW in April 2026 and explained his creative philosophy, emphasizing his commitment to working with younger talent and diverse roster combinations under Tony Khan's direction. Jericho reflected on how modern wrestling differs significantly from the Attitude and Ruthless Aggression Eras in terms of star power and drawing ability, noting that the roster depth today allows him to take a less prominent role while still contributing meaningfully.

stories.title: Dax Harwood Independent Wrestling Discussion
stories.tldr: Dax Harwood of FTR criticized wrestlers with television experience for phoning in their performances at independent wrestling shows, stating he and Cash Wheeler have never taken a night off during their indie bookings. Harwood emphasized that established wrestlers have a responsibility to the promoters and fans who pay to see them, and that failing to deliver hurts the entire promotion.

stories.title: AEW All In Thekla Status
stories.tldr: Thekla remains without an announced match for AEW All In despite being penciled in for the show, according to wrestling insider Sean Ross Sapp. The wrestler has built significant momentum on television this year but may lose that momentum if AEW doesn't provide her with a worthwhile program. Her recent title loss to make way for plans involving Willow Nightingale and Mercedes Moné is being viewed as a forced creative decision.

stories.title: Darby Allin AEW WWE Competition
stories.tldr: Darby Allin has expressed enthusiasm about AEW and WWE going head-to-head, stating that competition brings out the best work from wrestlers. WWE and AEW will counter-program major events on September 26 in Chicago, marking the third such occurrence in just over a year. Allin believes that having your back against the wall creatively produces stronger in-ring product, while also noting that wrestling doesn't consume his entire life.

stories.title: MJF NJPW G1 Climax 2027 Invitation
stories.tldr: MJF declined an invitation from 2026 G1 Climax winner Ryohei Oiwa to participate in next year's tournament after tweeting that he is a superior headlock wrestler. MJF responded dismissively to Oiwa's challenge and stated he has nothing left to prove, claiming he already is "the best in the world." The exchange highlighted tension between the AEW star and the NJPW champion ahead of Oiwa's title defense at King of Pro-Wrestling.

stories.title: Jay White First Child Announcement
stories.tldr: AEW star Jay White and his wife Savanna Rae White are expecting their first child together in February 2027, as announced via Instagram. White has recently returned to AEW programming following an injury and is currently competing in the Continental Challenge Cup tournament. The couple married in May 2022.

stories.title: AEW Continental Challenge Cup Tournament
stories.tldr: Nigel McGuinness has been medically cleared to continue in the Continental Challenge Cup despite suffering a foot injury, revealing there is no break or fracture. The quarterfinal bracket is now complete with McGuinness facing Hechicero on Dynamite, Jon Moxley taking on Jay White also on Dynamite, and Eddie Kingston vs. Claudio Castagnoli and Orange Cassidy vs. Kyle O'Reilly both scheduled for Collision. The semifinals will take place in Glasgow on August 26, with the finals at Wembley Stadium during All In on August 30.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone Willow Nightingale Injury Therapy
stories.tldr: Mercedes Moné has revealed in her latest Moné Mag column that therapy was necessary to help her stop blaming Willow Nightingale for the 2023 injury that sidelined her for a year. Moné initially obsessed over details like Nightingale's hand positioning on the ropes and lack of space on the turnbuckle, but eventually came to accept it as a freak accident and a sign to focus on holistic healing rather than just physical recovery.

stories.title: Oba Femi vs. Bron Breakker Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced Oba Femi vs. Bron Breakker for Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 in Atlanta to determine who is the true future of WWE. The match was made official on the August 17 episode of Raw when Paul Heyman intervened before the two young powerhouses could brawl, deciding the showdown was too big for an impromptu match. Heyman's actions, including shaking Femi's hand while distancing himself from Breakker, have added additional intrigue to the already heated rivalry.

stories.title: WWE RAW Double Taping August 24
stories.tldr: WWE will tape both the August 24 episode of RAW in Ottawa and the August 28 episode of SmackDown on the same night, requiring RAW to start at 6:00 PM ET instead of its usual time. The company is conducting two double tapings within five days to record four episodes across just two nights, giving wrestlers and production staff extra time off before a South American tour. The August 24 RAW will feature World Heavyweight Championship tournament semifinals, Stephanie Vaquer's return match, and a contract signing between Oba Femi and Bron Breakker.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa Rejects The Bloodline
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa rejected The Bloodline on the August 17 episode of WWE RAW, turning on Roman Reigns with a Samoan Spike after being ordered to attack LA Knight. The moment marked a significant babyface turn for Sikoa, who stood tall with Knight at the end of the segment while Jacob Fatu mysteriously refused to intervene. Backstage reaction to Sikoa's character change has been overwhelmingly positive both on and off screen.

stories.title: Maximum Male Models Vince McMahon Final Idea
stories.tldr: Maximum Male Models was revealed to be one of Vince McMahon's final creative ideas before his July 2022 departure from WWE. The faction was originally conceived as a weeks-long series of fashion show segments, including peculiar live event appearances where performers would simply do poses and leave without physical confrontation. After Triple H took over creative direction, the group pivoted to greater creative autonomy, launching a self-written YouTube series called "Making it Maximum" and eventually evolving into different roles, with Maxxine Dupri going on to work with The Vision on Raw before both Mansoor and Mace were released in September 2023.

stories.title: AJ Styles LA Knight World Champion Push
stories.tldr: AJ Styles has become a vocal advocate for LA Knight to finally receive a World Championship opportunity in WWE, repeatedly arguing on his podcast that Knight possesses all the necessary tools both in-ring and as a company representative. Knight, who has been pursuing the World Heavyweight Championship for years without success, appears positioned for a potential Money in the Bank match against Roman Reigns, with Styles emphasizing that Knight is more than ready for the moment.

stories.title: Rey Fenix and Dragon Lee World Heavyweight Championship Tournament
stories.tldr: Rey Fenix and Dragon Lee both advanced through the first round of the World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender's Tournament on WWE Raw, setting up a semifinal matchup between the two competitors. Dragon Lee defeated El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. with Operation Dragon, while Fenix beat El Fiscal with a Mexican Muscle Buster. The tournament winner will earn a championship opportunity against Roman Reigns when Raw heads to Mexico City later this year.

stories.title: Lance Anoa'i Wrestling Retirement 2027
stories.tldr: Lance Anoa'i, a 34-year-old member of the legendary Anoai family, announced he will retire from professional wrestling in March 2027 after reaching 17 years in the business. His decision is motivated by a desire to spend more time with his wife and children after years of sacrificing family time for wrestling. He will continue competing for several more months before his retirement and expressed pride in his family's continued accomplishments in the industry.

stories.title: Janel Grant Hospitalization and Accident
stories.tldr: Janel Grant, the former WWE employee whose 2024 lawsuit against Vince McMahon led to his resignation, was recently hospitalized after a serious fall at home in late July or early August. She suffered a concussion, broken ribs, and a lung hemorrhage, with no memory of the days following the accident. Grant connected the fall to years of physical and emotional deterioration since June 2022, but expressed gratitude for the people who detected her distress and ensured she received medical care.

stories.title: Carmelo Hayes WWE Backstage Reputation
stories.tldr: Despite inconsistent booking on WWE television, Carmelo Hayes maintains a strong backstage reputation within the company. According to Fightful Select's Sean Ross Sapp, Hayes is consistently described as dependable, professional, and having significant upside, with no reported negative sentiment toward him. The issue appears to be WWE's creative decisions rather than any internal concerns about Hayes' abilities or character.

stories.title: Stephanie Vaquer WWE RAW Return
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer will return to in-ring competition next week on Raw in Ontario, Canada, facing Roxanne Perez of the Judgment Day. Vaquer's return match comes after she called out Liv Morgan on this week's show but was attacked by the Judgment Day with Becky Lynch's help leading to confrontation. The show will feature an early 6 pm ET start time due to a double taping, and will also include tournament matches determining the new number one contender for Roman Reigns' World Heavyweight Championship.

stories.title: Bronson Reed WWE Return Physique Update
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed continues to post physique updates on social media as he recovers from a torn right biceps suffered on February 23 during a Men's Elimination Chamber qualifying match. The 37-year-old has been sidelined for nearly six months and is approaching the end of his four to six month recovery window, though WWE has not yet announced his return date or confirmed medical clearance. Reed's injury cost him a spot in the Elimination Chamber match and a WrestleMania 42 appearance at a time when he had built significant momentum as a key member of The Vision faction.

stories.title: Bron Breakker Logan Paul Vision
stories.tldr: Bron Breakker appears dissatisfied with his position in Logan Paul's stable The Vision, eyeing Oba Femi who has emerged as the promoted "future of WWE." Logan Paul acknowledges Femi as "a little bit of a problem" for The Vision while recovering from a torn triceps injury, with multiple wrestlers being considered as potential replacements for Breakker in the group.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Four Horsemen Heel Turn
stories.tldr: Wrestling author David Shoemaker has proposed that Cody Rhodes could be the ideal candidate to revive The Four Horsemen faction as a sophisticated heel character in WWE. Rather than requiring a complete personality transformation, Shoemaker suggests Rhodes' existing traits of polished presentation and confidence could be reframed as villainous, creating a faction of well-dressed, proud individuals who function as antagonists while maintaining the traditional storytelling structure of professional wrestling.

stories.title: WWE Hawaii Live Events October 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has announced a second live event for its 2026 Hawaii return, adding a Saturday, October 17 show at Blaisdell Arena in Honolulu following the nearly sold-out Friday, October 16 event. The company is citing popular demand for the addition and will feature WWE Superstars including Seth Rollins, The Usos, Jacob Fatu, Oba Femi, and Liv Morgan. This marks WWE's first return to Hawaii since September 2019.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Charles Robinson WWE Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash has made a strong statement that WWE referee Charles Robinson deserves to be a "first-ballot" Hall of Famer, saying he should be removed from the Hall of Fame himself if Robinson doesn't get inducted. Nash made these comments while defending Avery Styles in the ongoing controversy about whether younger wrestlers should be required to help set up and tear down the ring, arguing that ring assembly is a crucial technical skill that requires experienced professionals.

stories.title: Stevie Richards Chyna and Triple H Working Experience
stories.tldr: Stevie Richards revealed that working with Chyna was complicated not because of her personally, but due to backstage politics involving Triple H's influence and her protected status in WWE. Creative decisions had to navigate multiple approval layers, and pitching ideas became difficult when Chyna disagreed with suggestions. Despite her undeniable popularity and talent, the political environment surrounding her made collaboration "kind of a nightmare" for other wrestlers.

stories.title: WWE NXT House Show CM Punk and Grayson Waller
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller confronted CM Punk backstage at a WWE NXT house show in Petersburg, Virginia on August 15, with WWE promoting the confrontation on social media. Waller is set to address both the encounter with Punk and the arrival of newly signed Zilla Fatu during the August 18 episode of WWE NXT on The CW.

stories.title: Danhausen WWE Title Shot Attempt
stories.tldr: Danhasus posted off-air footage showing him approaching RAW General Manager Adam Pearce with an unconventional pitch for a title shot. Noting that Gunther received a championship opportunity after attacking SmackDown GM Nick Aldis at SummerSlam, Danhausen asked if beating up Pearce would earn him the same reward. Pearce quickly shut down the idea and simply told Danhausen to leave with his prop weapon.

stories.title: WWE Raw Women's Roster Additions
stories.tldr: WWE's Raw women's division is severely depleted with only 9 active wrestlers, prompting discussion of roster additions in 2026. The article examines six potential callups from NXT and SmackDown, including Jordynne Grace, Giulia, Lola Vice, Kelani Jordan, Candice LeRae, and the eventual return of Bianca Belair, who recently gave birth and is expected back sometime in the future.

stories.title: Lainey Reid Chelsea Green WWE Injury
stories.tldr: Lainey Reid of Fatal Influence addressed her role in breaking Chelsea Green's orbital bone during a tag team match at SummerSlam 2026, claiming she only felt remorse for not "finishing the job" and attributing the injury to Fatal Influence's strong style wrestling. Green successfully defended her newly won Interim WWE Women's Championship despite the injury after an impassioned speech to GM Nick Aldis, though her tag partner Tiffany Stratton lost her WWE Women's United States Championship while helping her recover from attacks.

stories.title: Ultimate Warrior WrestleMania 6 WWE Championship Decision
stories.tldr: WWE's decision to make Ultimate Warrior WWE Champion at WrestleMania 6 was actually justified based on the business metrics of 1990, as Warrior was clearly the number two draw trending upward while Hogan was peaking. However, Warrior's personal issues, introverted personality, and poor creative booking with weak opponents immediately following his title win ultimately undermined what could have been a successful reign.

stories.title: WWE Championship Next Holders
stories.tldr: Following WrestleMania 42, WWE is poised for significant championship changes across its main roster as only Roman Reigns and Liv Morgan retain their titles. The article predicts the next holders of every major WWE championship, including Charlotte Flair potentially winning the Women's United States Championship, Shinsuke Nakamura and Hiromu Takahashi challenging for the WWE Tag Team Championship, and The Usos positioning themselves to challenge for the World Tag Team Championship.

stories.title: WWE LFG Season Three Purpose
stories.tldr: Season three of WWE LFG has lost its appeal because most competitors were already on NXT, released, or sent to other promotions before the show even aired, making the competition for an NXT contract feel pointless. The critic argues that knowing the participants' fates in advance removes all investment in their journey and makes the show feel formulaic and predictable, questioning whether the series should continue.

stories.title: WWE Judgment Day New Member
stories.tldr: The Judgment Day faction, currently led by Liv Morgan and Dominik Mysterio with three championship titles among five members, could be expanding soon. The article explores six potential new members who could join the group, ranging from AAA talent like Omos and Dorian Roldan to WWE stars like Lyra Valkyria and the newly signed Aalyah Mysterio, Dom's sister.

stories.title: Diana Hart WWE British Bulldog Merchandise Support
stories.tldr: Diana Hart revealed that WWE's continued merchandising and licensing of British Bulldog following Davey Boy Smith's death provided crucial financial support for her family during a difficult period. Hart emphasized that the McMahon family's decision to keep Bulldog's legacy alive through merchandise was not charity, but rather well-deserved recognition of Smith's contributions to the company. The family had been rebuilding after experiencing bankruptcy, and WWE's support helped Hart provide for their children Harry and Georgia.

stories.title: Carmelo Hayes Kelani Jordan Wedding Plans
stories.tldr: Carmelo Hayes has confirmed that he and WWE NXT star fiancée Kelani Jordan will get married in October of this year. Hayes praised Jordan as one of the best performers in the wrestling business and commended her ability to balance her wrestling career with wedding planning while traveling on the road with WWE.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio Fan Chant Preferences
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio, currently one of WWE's most heavily booed performers, discussed what kind of fan chant he would want to hear if audiences ever got behind him. During an interview, he suggested fans could create a mariachi-style chant incorporating his name or some other Mexican-inspired variation. For now, Mysterio remains consistently booed, with crowd noise often drowning out his promos.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Love Island Opportunity Rejection
stories.tldr: WWE star Blake Monroe turned down multiple opportunities to appear on "Love Island" due to concerns about how she would react to the show's dramatic situations. She admitted that scenarios involving romantic betrayals would likely bring out her worst behavior. Monroe ultimately decided against the opportunity after finding love in her personal life, making reality dating TV unnecessary.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Triple H Donald Trump Photos
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash defended Triple H's public appearances with Donald Trump on his podcast, explaining that the photos are staged formal events and criticizing fans who question them. Nash pointed out that Triple H rarely wears ties in normal WWE appearances, and noted that Triple H's mother-in-law is connected to the Trump administration.

stories.title: WWE RAW August 17 2026 Ticket Sales
stories.tldr: WWE RAW is taking place tonight from the KeyBank Center in Buffalo, NY, with 9,354 tickets distributed as of the latest update, representing a 334-ticket increase from the previous day. The show features an Intercontinental Championship match between Chad Gable and Rey Mysterio, two World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender Tournament first-round matches, and an appearance by Roman Reigns. Ticket prices start at $44.90 with approximately 205 tickets remaining on the resale market.

stories.title: WWE RAW Start Time August 17 2026
stories.tldr: WWE RAW airs tonight from KeyBank Center in Buffalo, NY at 8pm ET, with Chad Gable defending the Intercontinental Championship against Rey Mysterio and the World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 Contender Tournament continuing with first-round matches. Roman Reigns is scheduled to appear, and the card also features Sol Roca vs. Lyra Valkyria along with tournament matches between Dragon Lee vs. El Hijo del Dr. Wagner Jr and Rey Fenix vs. El Fiscal.

stories.title: CM Punk and Kevin Owens Rivalry
stories.tldr: Following Punk's "fat ass" comment on SmackDown, wrestling veterans Bully Ray and Jinder Mahal criticized the insult as ineffective and potentially damaging to Punk's babyface status. Additionally, Punk drew criticism for calling the WWE locker room "his," which commentators viewed as egomaniacal, and Grayson Waller confronted Punk backstage at an NXT live event demanding respect.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Debut
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu opened up about his NXT debut on Booker T's Hall of Fame show, calling it a memory he'll never forget and expressing that he felt his late father's presence before making his entrance. Cruz Montana has publicly called out Fatu ahead of the August 18 NXT episode, making it personal and promising to confront him directly rather than just talking on social media. The confrontation between the two will air on The CW on August 18.

stories.title: Jacob Fatu WWE Addiction and Advice
stories.tldr: Jacob Fatu opened up about nearly losing his WWE contract before he even started due to substance abuse issues, revealing a harrowing 19-day period when he couldn't tell his family if he had a job. He also detailed struggling with cocaine and alcohol on the independent scene, including no-showing a Booker T event at his lowest point, before finally getting sober after Prichard's call. Additionally, Fatu recalled feeling physically overwhelmed during an in-ring segment with Roman Reigns and Seth Rollins, unsure if he was experiencing a panic attack.

stories.title: Nikki Cross Vince McMahon Superhero Character
stories.tldr: Nikki Cross revealed she created the superhero character concept herself and pitched it to Vince McMahon with a full presentation. McMahon approved the idea but modified it to "Almost a Super Hero" to make the character more relatable—inspired by Spider-Man's DIY aesthetic rather than big-budget superhero films—so young fans could easily cosplay as her.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes ALS Ice Bucket Challenge Rebel
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes has completed his ALS Ice Bucket Challenge video in support of Rebel, nominating Brodie Lee Jr., Brooke Havok, and Chelsea Green to participate next. Rhodes directed viewers to the I Am ALS website for donations. The wrestling community's fundraising efforts will culminate in AEW's "Rebel Heart" edition of Dynamite on September 9 in Athens, Georgia.

stories.title: Lola Vice AAA Farewell Main Roster WWE
stories.tldr: Lola Vice has officially said goodbye to AAA after losing the AAA World Mixed Tag Team Titles with Mr. Iguana at Verano de Escándalo, marking her transition to WWE's main roster. Vice credited her time in Mexico with rebuilding her confidence and wrestling skills, and thanked her tag team partner Mr. Iguana for teaching her to enjoy the moment in the ring. While her main roster debut timing remains unconfirmed, Vice promised to return to AAA as a bigger star.

stories.title: Blue Meanie ECW Wrestler Injuries
stories.tldr: The Blue Meanie (Brian Heffron), a former ECW and WWE wrestler, announced on Instagram that he is dealing with broken ribs from a recent fall and is experiencing significant pain while also grieving a death in his family. His "Mind of Meanie" podcast has paused new episodes for several weeks to allow him time to recover, with reruns of previous episodes airing in the meantime.

stories.title: TNA Plus VIP Premium Membership Program
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has launched TNA+ VIP, a premium membership program featuring the first-ever monthly subscription option ($19.99/month) that includes access to all pay-per-view events, alongside exclusive content and member perks. An annual plan is available at $129.99 ($99.99 with promo code TNA2026), and a free tier will continue to exist for non-premium content.

stories.title: Mistico CMLL AEW Japan Discussion
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer conducted an exclusive interview with Mistico at Arena Mexico, where the wrestling legend discussed CMLL's record-setting business performance, his experiences wrestling for AEW, his career in Japan, and his remaining professional goals. The special interview was conducted with interpreter Miguel Castro on the set of CMLL Informa and is available on YouTube and major podcast platforms.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling PPV Schedule 2026
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has announced three major pay-per-view events scheduled for 2026, including Lockdown in Chicago on August 23, Bound for Glory in Tampa on October 11, and Destination X in Edmonton on November 15. All three events will be available to watch on TNA+ and through traditional linear PPV providers and streamers.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown Cedric Alexander Leon Slater Stipulation
