stories.tldr: Nick Wayne, the ROH World Title No. 1 contender set to challenge Bandido for the championship next Friday at Death Before Dishonor, took a loss on AEW Dynamite in a three-way match. Dave Meltzer explained that the decision to have Wayne take the pin was made because Mike Bailey has a higher ranking in AEW, though Wayne should theoretically be ranked higher given his title shot status. This reflects Tony Khan's pattern of not protecting ROH champions outside of ROH programming.

stories.title: AEW Hiring Behind-Scenes Roles
stories.tldr: AEW is expanding its behind-the-scenes operations by hiring for two new positions: a Producer, Motion Graphics role in Nashville focused on television post-production, and an Accounting Manager for Live Events position in Jacksonville handling financial responsibilities for touring operations. Both openings reflect the company's commitment to maintaining quality production standards and efficient event management as it continues its full television and touring schedule.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Men's Casino Gauntlet
stories.tldr: AEW All In London 2026 takes place on August 30 at Wembley Stadium, featuring the Men's Casino Gauntlet match with a guaranteed AEW World Title shot for the winner. The article highlights seven potential winners including MJF, Tommaso Ciampa, Komander, "Jungle" Jack Perry, Chris Jericho, Speedball Mike Bailey, and Andrade El Idolo, who is positioned as the top contender.

stories.title: MJF Roman Reigns Nickname Distance
stories.tldr: MJF has aggressively pushed back against fans using the acronym "OTC" for his new "One True Champion" gimmick, demanding people never acronym the monicker and dismissing merchandise comparisons to Roman Reigns' "Original Tribal Chief" nickname. Meanwhile, reports confirm MJF was always planned for AEW All In's Casino Gauntlet match rather than challenging for the World Championship, with both he and Andrade El Idolo set to be focal points of that bout.

stories.title: AEW Jeff Jarrett on WWE Star Direction
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett has publicly advised Dominik Mysterio to advocate for himself creatively within WWE, suggesting he's established enough in his career to demand a different direction. Jarrett noted the stark contrast between Mysterio's prominent booking as AAA Mega Champion versus his diminished role on WWE television, where he's posted a 3-20 record this year.

stories.title: Former WWE Stars to Join AEW
stories.tldr: Kingston and Woods are now expected to debut at AEW's All In London event at Wembley Stadium on August 30, where they could face Adam Copeland and Christian Cage in a potential tag team match. AEW is also targeting other recently departed WWE talents including Sheamus, Bayley, and Kairi Sane to strengthen its roster ahead of the show.

stories.title: AEW All In MJF and Andrade Plans
stories.tldr: Wrestling insiders are discussing the potential AEW debut of former New Day members at the All In event. The podcast covered this topic alongside other major wrestling news including creative concerns with The Bloodline storyline and analysis of recent Dark Side of the Ring episodes.

stories.title: Jacob Fatu WWE Second Chance and Addiction
stories.tldr: Jacob Fatu has opened up about nearly losing his WWE opportunity before he was even hired due to personal addiction issues. Triple H ultimately gave him a second chance, and after competing at WrestleMania 42 (a number with special cultural significance to Fatu), the two shared an emotional backstage encounter where Triple H credited Fatu with doing the work himself. The story highlights themes of redemption, personal responsibility, and the importance of second chances.

stories.title: Jacy Jayne Wins Women's United States Championship
stories.tldr: Jacy Jayne won the WWE Women's United States Championship on the August 14, 2026 episode of SmackDown, defeating defending champion Tiffany Stratton with help from her Fatal Influence stablemates. The finish saw Stratton choose to protect interim WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green at ringside rather than secure victory, allowing Jayne to capitalize with a Rolling Encore for the pinfall. This marks a major championship moment for the 30-year-old, who is one of the most decorated wrestlers in NXT history.

stories.title: MFTs Win WWE Tag Team Championship
stories.tldr: Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga won the WWE Tag Team Championship on August 14 SmackDown in a triple threat match, defeating defending champions Damian Priest and R-Truth along with The War Raiders. The victory marked Talla's first WWE title while Tama earned his third tag team championship. The MFTs' father Haku, who recently returned to WWE, was at ringside to celebrate the win.

stories.title: Pat McAfee Music Album Release
stories.tldr: Pat McAfee, the former WWE commentator, has officially released his debut album "The Diary Of A Polarizing Figure" on August 14, 2026, after spending two decades writing songs about his life and experiences. The 14-track, 42-minute project is available on Spotify and YouTube and follows his 2025 single "Dookie." While some sports personalities praised the album, it has drawn significant criticism from fans and social media users questioning McAfee's decision to pursue music.

stories.title: Shinsuke Nakamura Tag Team Partner Tease
stories.tldr: Shinsuke Nakamura has teased a mystery tag team partner to challenge the newly crowned MFTs (Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga) for the WWE Tag Team Championship. In a post-SmackDown digital exclusive, Nakamura described his partner as a "ticking time bomb" who is experienced, vicious, and deadly—language that strongly suggests the partner is Hiromu Takahashi, the former IWPW Junior Heavyweight Champion who departed New Japan Pro Wrestling in February and is expected to have signed with WWE.

stories.title: Paige SmackDown Segment Cut
stories.tldr: Paige's scheduled WWE SmackDown promo was cut from the August 14 broadcast, prompting her to react on social media with criticism about women's segments being eliminated. She fired back at Nikki Bella's claims about revitalizing her career, and WWE later posted the unaired promo as a digital exclusive while the feud between the two wrestlers continues online and heading into the following week's show.

stories.title: August 14 WWE SmackDown Title Changes and Results
stories.tldr: The August 14, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown in Boston featured two title changes as the MFTs won the WWE World Tag Team Championship in a three-way match, and Jacy Jayne of Fatal Influence captured the WWE Women's United States Championship from Tiffany Stratton. The show also saw Baron Corbin retain his United States Championship against Carmelo Hayes, while General Manager Nick Aldis gave Chelsea Green 30 days to get medically cleared or risk losing her WWE Women's Interim Championship.

stories.title: The Rock Under Armour Partnership End
stories.tldr: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson has ended his 10-year partnership with Under Armour, which produced the Project Rock clothing and footwear line featuring his signature Brahma Bull logo. The split was amicable, with Under Armour continuing to distribute existing inventory through October 2026. Johnson and his ex-wife and business partner Dany Garcia, who own the Project Rock trademark, are now seeking a new manufacturing partner to continue the brand.

stories.title: Jerry Lawler Bill Dundee One More Match
stories.tldr: Jerry Lawler has teased the possibility of one more match with Bill Dundee during a Memphis Wrestling event in Tupelo, Mississippi benefiting St. Jude Children's Research Hospital. While no match has been officially announced, Lawler has previously stated he hasn't ruled out returning to the ring despite suffering two strokes in recent years and rating his health at around six or seven out of ten.

stories.title: Baron Corbin Retains Men's US Title
stories.tldr: Baron Corbin successfully retained the WWE United States Championship against Carmelo Hayes on SmackDown, hitting End of Days for the victory. However, the celebration was short-lived as Trick Williams emerged and Lil Yachty attacked Corbin with a kendo stick, with Williams following up with a Trick Shot to stand tall over the champion, setting up further tensions between the rivals.

stories.title: Johnny Knoxville and Sami Zayn Feud
stories.tldr: Johnny Knoxville posted a fake apology video to Sami Zayn while promoting his latest Jackass film, only to immediately continue insulting him. Zayn fired back with a brutal response, wishing Knoxville would suffer another traumatic brain injury while watching the movie, escalating their long-running feud that began after their WrestleMania 39 match.

stories.title: Trick Williams CM Punk Comparison
stories.tldr: Trick Williams has declared himself a superior trash-talker to CM Punk, claiming his natural ability to talk trash has been passed down through his DNA and extends back decades beyond either competitor's lifetime. Following his loss of the United States Championship to Baron Corbin at SummerSlam, Williams expressed interest in pursuing Money in the Bank and reclaiming his title, while remaining open to a verbal confrontation with Punk.

stories.title: Trick Williams and The Undertaker NXT Confrontation
stories.tldr: Trick Williams revealed that his aggressive promo confrontation with The Undertaker on NXT was completely improvised, with no backstage discussion beforehand about what he would say or how Undertaker would respond. Williams called it his "most risky work," throwing out a bold threat without knowing if it would backfire, but the gamble paid off as he earned Undertaker's respect before taking a chokeslam. The segment was particularly meaningful for Williams, who had been terrified of Undertaker as a child and never even selected him in wrestling video games.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Future Plans
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes plans to continue his wrestling career until Brodie Lee Jr., the teenage son of late AEW star Brodie Lee, is ready to have a match with him, potentially taking breaks and returning as needed. In separate comments, Rhodes also revealed that his iconic neck tattoo, the American Nightmare logo, is his greatest regret in life due to its unexpected size and placement, though it has become inseparable from his brand and merchandise.

stories.title: Randy Orton Interrupts Cody Rhodes vs Sami Zayn
stories.tldr: Randy Orton attacked Cody Rhodes before the scheduled main event against Sami Zayn could begin on the August 14 episode of WWE SmackDown, turning the match into a brawl that spilled outside the ring. The altercation continued through the crowd and back toward ringside, ultimately forcing officials to intervene and causing the main event to be scrapped entirely, leaving Sami Zayn unable to compete as planned.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels Photo Revisit
stories.tldr: Shawn Michaels recently participated in a WWE challenge where young talents recreated iconic wrestler poses. When Michaels drew himself, he humorously recreated his famous 1996 Playgirl pictorial pose with the WWF Championship, later joking on Instagram that he should have known better than to trust the options provided.

stories.title: Jeff Cobb WWE Offers
stories.tldr: Jeff Cobb turned down WWE's contract offers on three separate occasions before finally accepting on the fourth attempt. His reasons ranged from not wanting to relocate to Florida, to having recently signed with New Japan, to finding a FaceTime call with an executive amusing. Ultimately, Triple H's personal FaceTime call and reminder that Cobb wasn't getting any younger convinced him to sign, leading to his WWE debut at Backlash 2025 before his release in May 2026.

stories.title: Paul Heyman WWE Client Update
stories.tldr: Paul Heyman is currently without a client after Brock Lesnar's retirement and his split from The Vision, leaving the door open for a new management partnership. Several WWE stars are being considered as potential next clients, including Bron Breakker, Oba Femi, Bronson Reed, Jordynne Grace, Randy Orton, and NXT prospect Keanu Carver, each offering different storyline possibilities.

stories.title: Seth Rollins TNA Star Training
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins continues to provide feedback and support to TNA star M By Elegance (Maggie Lee) even after she completed a three-month training program at his Black and Brave Wrestling Academy in Iowa. Rollins remains available to critique her matches and actively participated in training sessions, including wrestling matches with students. Lee recently advanced to the Knockouts Television Championship Tournament final after defeating Indi Hartwell.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth Comments on Shinsuke Nakamura Booking
stories.tldr: Nic Nemeth recently discussed his 2017 Backlash match against Shinsuke Nakamura, revealing he pitched an MMA-style finish to Vince McMahon that was rejected in favor of a traditional WWE match. Nemeth believes the creative approach could have better established Nakamura's momentum on the main roster, though he praised Nakamura as an exceptional performer. Nakamura has since experienced inconsistent booking throughout his WWE tenure despite multiple championship reigns.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff WWE Shareholder Settlement
stories.tldr: WWE and TKO Group agreed to settle a shareholder lawsuit stemming from the company's merger with UFC for $147.5 million, with Vince McMahon responsible for $42.5 million and TKO covering $105 million. Eric Bischoff characterized the settlement as a standard "cost of doing business" and speculated that McMahon's insurance policy likely covers most or all of his portion of the payout.

stories.title: Diana Hart Bret Hart Feud Storyline
stories.tldr: Diana Hart revealed that WWE originally wanted her to physically attack her brother Bret Hart during a storyline with her husband the British Bulldog, using thorn-covered roses that would cut and make him bleed. The dangerous segment was scripted to begin as an apparent honoring ceremony before turning violent. An unnamed family member objected to the idea, leading WWE to ultimately scrap the dangerous angle.

stories.title: JBL Two-Night Royal Rumble ESPN Push
stories.tldr: JBL theorizes that ESPN is pushing WWE to expand the 2027 Royal Rumble to two nights, capitalizing on the event's placement during the quiet weekend between NFL Conference Championships and the Super Bowl. The timing would help ESPN keep sports viewers engaged during a typically slow period on the American sporting calendar. While no official announcement has been made, the move aligns with WWE's new ESPN relationship and the network's existing two-night format for SummerSlam.

stories.title: Jinder Mahal The Rock WWE Segment
stories.tldr: Jinder Mahal revealed backstage details about his unexpected segment with The Rock on WWE RAW Day 1, which became a viral moment with over 9.5 million YouTube views. Mahal received the promo script only hours before going live and had minimal notice, yet the segment was well-received and generated more fan reaction than when he won the WWE Championship. The Rock even sent him a voice message thanking him, and the moment marked the beginning of The Rock's return to WWE before his eventual WrestleMania 40 feud with Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event September 6
stories.tldr: WWE will present Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 from Atlanta, Georgia for the first time. With only three weeks to build the card, the event could feature six potential matches including title defenses, returning superstar grudges, and matches between rising stars competing for main event status.

stories.title: AEW and WWE Stars at Zuffa Boxing
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that AJ Styles and LA Knight will appear at Zuffa Boxing 11 in London this September as part of a VIP experience package. The boxing event takes place at Copper Box Park in Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park and features fights including Craig Richards vs Radivoje Kalajdzic for the light heavyweight division.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Interim Women's Championship Status
stories.tldr: On SmackDown, GM Nick Aldis initially demanded Chelsea Green relinquish her interim title due to her broken orbital bone, but ultimately gave her 30 days to get medically cleared before she must defend it. The segment also saw Gunther confront Green, leading to a match between Gunther and Matt Cardona, with Tiffany Stratton making the save afterward when Nia Jax and Lash Legend attacked.

stories.title: CM Punk and Kevin Owens WWE Rivalry
stories.tldr: Punk and Owens had an intense face-to-face confrontation on SmackDown where they aired 20 years of personal grievances, with Owens specifically referencing a humiliating locker room incident from their ROH days over Owens' choice to wear a shirt instead of a singlet. Owens also attacked Punk's ally Danhausen at a live event to send a message ahead of their August 21 title match in Toronto.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Debut and Bloodline
stories.tldr: Wrestling veterans have weighed in with contrasting advice on Zilla Fatu's path forward, with Bully Ray suggesting he could eventually replace Roman Reigns while Matt Hardy warns against rushing him into the Bloodline too quickly. Meanwhile, Cruz Montana has vowed to settle unfinished business with Fatu after the interruption cost him a championship opportunity.

stories.title: Haku WWE MFTs Manager Status
stories.tldr: Haku's involvement with his sons Tama and Talla Tonga as their manager appears to be expanding beyond a one-off return. The legendary WWE Hall of Famer is scheduled for another appearance on SmackDown in Boston, where the Tongas are challenging for the WWE Tag Team Championship in a triple threat match. However, WWE has not yet confirmed whether Haku has signed a full-time contract or the intended length of his return.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Oba Femi Heel Turn Opposition
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy has pushed back against Jinder Mahal's pitch to turn Oba Femi heel, arguing the rising star is already too popular with audiences to warrant a character change at this stage. Hardy emphasized the importance of maintaining Femi as a babyface who can represent the company, particularly noting the value of having a Black performer in that prominent role.

stories.title: Blake Monroe WWE SmackDown Debut
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe's first WWE main roster match has been officially booked against Giulia after a backstage segment with SmackDown GM Nick Aldis. The match was announced via off-air digital exclusive footage, though no date has been set. Monroe had suggested facing Chelsea Green for the WWE Women's Championship before Aldis made the decision himself.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Boston Logistics
stories.tldr: Ticket sales for tonight's SmackDown in Boston have improved slightly to 7,351 distributed, up 604 from the previous day, though the show remains well below comparable Raw attendance from earlier this year. The event begins at 8pm ET tonight from TD Garden with several title matches on the card.

stories.title: WWE Legend Returns and Merchandise
stories.tldr: WWE has released new merchandise for Haku following his return to television, where he's been appearing on SmackDown managing his sons Talla and Tama Tonga. The company has released two new shirts featuring his "Tongan Death Grip" finishing move. The merchandise release suggests WWE may be exploring bringing back more legends in managerial roles.

stories.title: Randy Orton and Alexa Bliss Live Event Returns
stories.tldr: The Manchester live event featured additional matches and storyline developments beyond Orton and Bliss's returns. R-Truth and Damian Priest retained the Tag Team Championship, Baron Corbin successfully defended the U.S. Championship, and tensions continue brewing in the main event picture with Orton, Punk, Rhodes, and Owens all advertised for Friday's SmackDown.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36
stories.tldr: NJPW G1 Climax 36 reaches its climax this weekend at Ryogoku Sumo Hall with semifinals on Saturday featuring Yota Tsuji vs. Yuya Uemura and Callum Newman vs. Ryohei Oiwa, while the finals take place Sunday. Expert analyst Tom Lawlor predicts Ryohei Oiwa will win the tournament by defeating Uemura in the final, with Uemura pulling off an upset over champion Tsuji in the semifinals. The card also features Hiroyoshi Tenzan's retirement match against Satoshi Kojima.

stories.title: Zelina Vega Post-WWE Indie Appearances
stories.tldr: Former WWE Superstar Zelina Vega, now performing under the ring name Xelina, has announced her first post-WWE wrestling appearances following her release as part of the post-WrestleMania 42 roster cuts. She will debut at House of Glory's Fallout event on September 4 in Los Angeles, and will also compete at PROGRESS Wrestling's Odyssey Tour in Manchester, England on September 6, the latter date shared with her husband Malakai Black.

stories.title: Historical Wrestling Matches and Title Changes August 14
stories.tldr: August 14 is a historically significant date in professional wrestling, marked by several classic matches and numerous title changes. The standout match is AJ Styles versus Hiroshi Tanahashi from 2015, rated 9.41 on Cagematch and ****3/4 by Dave Meltzer, while the date has also seen approximately 248 notable title changes throughout wrestling history, including CM Punk's famous 2011 WWE Championship victory.

stories.title: AAA Wrestling News
stories.tldr: AAA Wrestling has announced Rey Fenix will defend his AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against Noisy Boy on Saturday, August 15, 2026, at Coliseo Centenario in Torreon. The show will also feature a World Heavyweight Championship No. 1 contender's tournament first round match between Psycho Clown and La Parka, with appearances from Dominik Mysterio, El Grande Americano, and Penta. The event will air live on Fox and Fox One throughout Latin America and on YouTube in the United States.

stories.title: Alex Wright WCW Ric Flair Push
stories.tldr: Alex Wright credits two pivotal moments for his WCW success: Ric Flair's blunt intervention telling him to get in shape after weight gain and heavy drinking, and WCW's decision to have him incorporate his natural German techno dancing into his Das Wunderkind character. The dancing became so iconic that it defined his career, though it also overshadowed his wrestling abilities and eventually led him to pursue the darker Berlyn reinvention.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez Pro Wrestling for Dummies Book
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez's new book "Pro Wrestling for Dummies," illustrated by Gene Selassie, is now available for pre-order on Amazon with shipping expected in a few weeks, arriving by September 29. The comprehensive guide covers wrestling rules, history, major promotions like WWE and AEW, iconic wrestlers and matches, and where to watch events globally. This is Alvarez's third book and his first that doesn't reference dying in the title.

stories.title: Leon Slater WWE or AEW Decision
stories.tldr: Leon Slater will become a free agent in late 2026 after his TNA Wrestling contract expires, setting up a major decision between WWE and AEW. At just 21 years old, Slater has already made history as the youngest X-Division Champion and has experience on WWE's NXT brand through a partnership deal. Recent booking decisions in TNA, including putting his title on the line in a Steel Cage match, have created speculation that his WWE signing may not be the foregone conclusion many assumed.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Newsletter August 17
stories.tldr: The August 17, 2026 Wrestling Observer Newsletter covers major developments across multiple promotions including AEW All In's growing lineup, the final stretch of NJPW's G1 tournament, and the upcoming CMLL Anniversary show. The issue also features an extended retrospective on the legendary career of Dory Funk Jr. following his passing, analysis of a WWE shareholders lawsuit involving financial settlements for Vince McMahon and WWE, and coverage of the Arik Cannon/AJ Styles/Avery Styles controversy along with ratings and reviews.

stories.title: Watch:  C4 Wrestling presents FIGHTING BACK 15
stories.tldr: C4 Wrestling held Fighting Back: Wrestling With Cancer 15, a charity event live from Ottawa, Ontario. All funds raised at the event were donated to the Canadian Cancer Society in honor of Phrank Morin. The wrestling promotion continues its tradition of using the Fighting Back series to support cancer-related charitable causes.

stories.title: WWE's Charlotte Flair Talks Having A Chip On Her Shoulder Due To Her Father
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair has become so dominant in WWE that many fans now associate the Flair name with her rather than her legendary father, Ric Flair. Despite her 14-time world championship reign and major role in the Women's Revolution, Charlotte says she still carries a chip on her shoulder because of her father's iconic status as a crossover athlete. She expressed deep respect for Ric's passion and legacy while continuing her own career at age 40 on WWE SmackDown.

stories.title: Grand Slam 2 To Proceed Despite Rain Concerns, Delay Possible
stories.tldr: Grand Slam 2 wrestling event will proceed as scheduled Saturday, August 15 at Kokomo Municipal Stadium despite rain in the forecast. Event organizer Chris Owens stated the show will begin at 20:00 as planned, with organizers monitoring weather patterns and expecting rain to stop before start time, though a delay remains possible if conditions change.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Inquiring About The Availability Of MLB Pitcher For Raw Appearance
stories.tldr: WWE has reportedly inquired about Milwaukee Brewers pitcher Jacob Misiorowski's availability to appear on Raw when the show comes to Milwaukee on September 28. The plan would involve Misiorowski, whose nickname is "The Miz," appearing in a segment with WWE veteran The Miz. However, his availability is uncertain due to the MLB playoffs beginning that same day, though the Brewers' strong division position makes their playoff appearance likely.

stories.title: WWE Star Pays The Price For Close Friendship With CM Punk At Live Event
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens attacked Danhausen at a WWE live event in Manchester, New Hampshire, sending a message to CM Punk ahead of their Undisputed WWE Championship match. The attack targeted Danhausen for his friendship with Punk, which dates back to their time together in AEW. CM Punk recently praised Danhausen as a perfect fit for WWE while joking that their relationship is based on paying him money to avoid being cursed.

stories.title: Wrestling Dues and Avery Styles Situation
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy and veteran trainer Les Thatcher have now weighed in on the Avery Styles situation, with Hardy arguing that Arik Cannon should have addressed the issue privately rather than on social media. Hardy pointed out that GCW paid to fly Avery in specifically because of his connection to AJ Styles, suggesting he wasn't obligated to help with setup duties. The industry conversation continues to focus on what "paying dues" actually means in professional wrestling.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown 2026 Partnership
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has announced cross-promotional partnerships with the Chicago Sky (WNBA) and Schaumburg Boomers (minor league baseball) ahead of Lockdown 2026. Several TNA wrestlers, including Mustafa Ali and Elayna Black, will make appearances at both teams' games in the days leading up to the August 23 event. Elayna Black will serve as honorary co-captain for the Sky game on August 21.

stories.title: Kofi Kingston Post-WWE Ring Name
stories.tldr: Kofi Kingston's trademark filings reveal the specific merchandise categories and entertainment services he plans to offer post-WWE, including clothing, wrestling performances, news content, and personal appearances. The detailed USPTO descriptions confirm Kingston is preparing a full entertainment operation outside of WWE, though his next destination remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Somehow, the Bloodline is almost back together. And it’s more of the same | Opinion
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa is being "delivered" to Roman Reigns after losing to Jey Uso on Raw, pulling the babyface into the Bloodline fold. An opinion piece argues the faction's near-complete reunion represents creative regression, with Jacob Fatu already reduced to a loyal foot soldier rather than the rising star he was earlier this year. The Bloodline storyline appears stuck in familiar patterns despite years of buildup suggesting progression.
